candidatePool.description: Players from the daily HR model with at least one at-bat across their previous five completed games. The page defaults to at least three at-bats across the previous two games.

dailyProfile.interpretation: Universal Day 21 (compound 21, root 3) emphasizes exact day matches and root-3 resonance. Primary family [3,6,9] favors players with birth-day 21, jersey 21, or life-path roots that reduce to 3.

narrative.closingObservation: Four candidates share the 21/3 signature, creating a concentrated cluster around exact-day and jersey alignment.
